metadata.purpose: Checksums of the Table 1 evaluation data the paper used. scripts/table1/prepare_data.py compares a prepared data root with them. Hashes and counts only.
metadata.metadata: co3d: sha256 of selected_seqs_test.json, the frame list of every sequence. arkitscenes and scannetpp: sha256 of each array in all_metadata.npz, with strings joined by newlines (UTF-8), integers as little-endian int64 and floats rounded with numpy.round(x, 4) as little-endian float64. For pairs only the two frame indices count; the loaders ignore the score.
metadata.files: number of image, depth, mask and camera files the metadata lists; all must exist
